lastCompletedStory.title: Regression-lock cam issue list as CAM_ISSUE_RESULT-free by design

nextStoryContext: This was the last story in the CAM-212 PRD (US-001 and US-002 both now passes:true). dispatchIssue's list branch (index.ts ~1564-1573) now carries an in-code comment documenting the deliberate mutation-outcome-contract decision, and test/issue-dispatch.test.ts has a new 'dispatchIssue: list mode is CAM_ISSUE_RESULT-free by design' regression test asserting the dispatcher never writes a CAM_ISSUE_RESULT line for mode:list, even when the injected issueListFn writes ordinary table output. src/commands/issue-list.ts (runIssueList internals) was NOT touched, per the story's explicit out-of-scope note; it was only verified read-only via negative grep. No further work is queued under this PRD; the next implementer invocation should find prd.json PRD_COMPLETE and exit without touching files.
